mapper.sql: select s.site_id, s.site_no, s.contract_id, s.customer_id, s.estate, s.area, s.key_password, s.designer_id, s.designer_name, s.supervisor_id, s.supervisor_name, s.start_date, s.finish_date, s.status, s.dept_id, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.remark, c.customer_name, c.phone as customer_phone, ct.contract_no, ct.contract_amount, ct.start_date as contract_start_date, ct.end_date as contract_end_date, ifnull(st.total_count, 0) as total_stages, ifnull(st.done_count, 0) as done_stages, cur.stage_type as current_stage_type, case when cur.stage_id is not null and cur.plan_end_date < curdate() then 1 else 0 end as late_flag from biz_site s left join crm_customer c on c.customer_id = s.customer_id left join biz_contract ct on ct.contract_id = s.contract_id left join ( select site_id, count(1) as total_count, sum(case when status = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as done_count from biz_progress_stage group by site_id ) st on st.site_id = s.site_id left join biz_progress_stage cur on cur.site_id = s.site_id and cur.status in ('0', '1') and cur.sort_order = ( select min(p.sort_order) from biz_progress_stage p where p.site_id = s.site_id and p.status in ('0', '1') )
mapper.select: select ct.contract_id, ct.contract_no, ct.customer_id, ct.contract_amount, ct.start_date, ct.end_date, ct.owner_user_id, c.customer_name, c.phone as customer_phone, c.estate, c.house_type, c.area, ou.nick_name as owner_user_name from biz_contract ct left join crm_customer c on c.customer_id = ct.customer_id left join sys_user ou on ou.user_id = ct.owner_user_id left join biz_site s on s.contract_id = ct.contract_id where ct.status = '2' and s.site_id is null order by ct.contract_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into biz_site (site_no, contract_id, customer_id, estate, area, key_password, designer_id, designer_name, supervisor_id, supervisor_name, start_date, status, dept_id, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{siteNo}, #{contractId}, #{customerId}, #{estate}, #{area}, #{keyPassword}, #{designerId}, #{designerName}, #{supervisorId}, #{supervisorName}, #{startDate}, #{status}, #{deptId}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
